snippet.title: Act Normal - Social Deduction game | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Act Normal is an online multiplayer social deduction and stealth game for 2–8 players, coming to PC on Steam.

Everyone looks like an NPC. Everyone is armed.

Blend into the crowd, act like an NPC, steal everything you can, and figure out who is actually another player before they figure out you. Every minute, whoever has stolen the least gets eliminated. No warning. No leaderboard.

Every steal is a risk. Stealing can expose you, but if you don't steal enough, you're eliminated.

Act Normal combines social deduction, hide and seek, stealth, deception, and party game mechanics in a multiplayer game where you can never be sure who to trust.
